kinds.assisted: a step on the bench, then judged from the packets
kinds.command: Runway sends the device a command, then judges its answer and what follows
kinds.manual: seen by the tester; status and remarks by hand

areas.title: Location service
areas.goal: Get a fast, reliable fix in all conditions and report position without false movement.

cases.what: Fix validity shown in every packet
Fix after wake from each sleep state
Tunnel crossing and fix on exit
Covered or underground parking, short and long stay
Device in its installed position inside the enclosure
No fix for a long period
GNSS module not responding, and recovery
Stationary filter on/off and its source

areas.title: Device time sync
areas.goal: Keep the device clock correct from the best available source.

cases.what: Source priority when more than one is available
Time at boot, before any sync
Drift during sleep over a day and across temperature
Clock change while stored data is queued (order kept)

areas.title: Sleep and wake-up cycle
areas.goal: Move correctly between Active, Stand-by, Sleep and Deep sleep, saving battery while staying reachable.

cases.what: Entry into and exit from Active
Entry into and exit from Stand-by
Entry into and exit from Sleep
Entry into and exit from Deep sleep
Sleep start event as the last packet before sleep
Wake on external power connect or disconnect

areas.title: LED patterns
areas.goal: Show device status clearly and consistently.

cases.what: Pattern for each state on the Power LED
Pattern for each state on the GPRS LED
Pattern for each state on the GNSS LED
Pattern for each state on the SOS LED
Priority when two states apply to one LED
Visibility through the housing, day and night
Whether that setting affects the SOS LED

areas.title: Driver behaviour
areas.goal: Detect harsh acceleration, braking and cornering accurately, without false alerts.

cases.what: Harsh cornering (left and right) at threshold
Event recorded with time and location
No network (event stored and sent later)

areas.title: SOS button and handling
areas.goal: Deliver an emergency alert reliably in every condition.

areas.title: OTA functionality
areas.goal: Update firmware and settings remotely and safely, with full control from the OTA platform.

cases.what: File for the wrong device rejected
Rollback when the new firmware fails to start
Install only when the vehicle is stopped
Update a single device and a group

areas.title: EOL, labels and PDI
areas.goal: Every unit tested, configured and onboarded before dispatch.

cases.what: Identity recorded (IMEI, serial number, eSIM ID)
Device visible on the OTA server and the platform
Device ID in the clause 3.1.1.12 format (manufacturer, model, test agency, MMYY, serial number), stored read-only

areas.title: Ignition detection
areas.goal: Detect ignition on and off correctly on 12 V and 24 V vehicles, and wake the device on ignition.

cases.what: Ignition on and off detected, with events

areas.title: External power monitoring
areas.goal: Report main power connection, disconnection and voltage across the 9 to 36 V range.

cases.what: Main power disconnect and reconnect alerts (EP_SENSE)
No false alerts from short dips

areas.title: Internal battery and charging
areas.goal: Keep the device running on its internal battery when main power is lost, and charge the battery safely.

cases.what: Charging starts and stops correctly (STC4054, CHG_ON/OFF)
Shutdown when the battery is nearly empty

areas.title: Digital and analog inputs
areas.goal: Read two digital and two analog inputs correctly for connected sensors.

cases.what: High and low detection on DIN1 and DIN2
Voltage reading on AIN1 and AIN2 across the range
Continuous high input at 24 V and above

areas.title: Digital outputs and immobilization
areas.goal: Drive outputs reliably and immobilize the vehicle safely on command.

cases.what: DOUT1 and DOUT2 on and off by command
Hooter and buzzer on DOUT1/2 on SOS
Hooter and buzzer on DOUT1/2 on Overspeed

areas.title: Tamper (cover open)
areas.goal: Detect when the device housing is opened.

cases.what: Cover-open alert from the light sensor (LDR)
No false alerts from light leaking through the housing
Tamper alert means GNSS box opened, distinct from emergency button tamper (DT)

areas.title: Cellular connectivity and eSIM
areas.goal: Stay connected to the network and server, and recover on its own from failures.

cases.what: Modem not responding, recovered by power cycle (GPRS_ON)
Network switching over OTA, on demand and automatically in real time
Download and activate a new network profile

areas.title: Data storage and offline buffer
areas.goal: Store data when offline and send it in order once the connection returns.

cases.what: Data stored in the 16 MB flash while offline and sent when the connection returns

areas.title: Movement and towing detection
areas.goal: Detect vehicle movement and towing from the motion sensor.

cases.what: Movement as a wake source (LSM6DSL INT1/INT2)
Towing alert when the vehicle moves with ignition off
No false movement from vibration, wind or nearby traffic

areas.title: CAN interface (CAN variant)
areas.goal: Read vehicle CAN data without disturbing the vehicle bus.

areas.title: RS232 interface and RFID reader
areas.goal: Connect external accessories, mainly the RFID reader, over RS232.

cases.what: RFID reader data received and reported
RS232 used for configuration and EOL
Reader and configuration sharing the same port
Tag read every 5 minutes and stored
Tag value pushed at a configurable frequency

areas.title: Bluetooth (BLE)
areas.goal: Allow local configuration, log download and firmware update over Bluetooth.

areas.title: Device configuration
areas.goal: Read and change every setting through SMS, GPRS, BLE and RS232, with the same result on each.

cases.what: Get, set and clear over SMS
Get, set and clear over GPRS
Get, set and clear over BLE
Get, set and clear over RS232
Settings kept after reset and after a firmware update

areas.title: Watchdog and recovery
areas.goal: Recover by itself from any hang or crash, without staying offline.

areas.title: InTouch packet integration
areas.goal: The device reports to InTouch over the MMI protocol, with login, PVT and alarm packets.

cases.what: Login packet on first connection and on every reconnection
PVT packet at the ignition-on and ignition-off intervals
Alarm packet for every alarm in the alarm list
Live and history packets, with history sent in order after a reconnect
Packet format and checksum as per the MMI protocol
Sending to InTouch, the government server and the emergency server in parallel, with no loss or delay

areas.title: Government server (State/UT backend) packets
areas.goal: Login, PVT, alarm and health packets sent to the state backend as specified in AIS-140 Amendment 3.

cases.what: Login packet (LGN) on every connect and reconnect
Each packet type: NR, EA, TA, HP, IN, IF, BD, BR, BL, HB, HA, RT, DT, OA, BC
Health check and activation response over SMS, on request

areas.title: Emergency server and SMS fallback
areas.goal: Emergency alerts reach the emergency server, and fall back to SMS to the Control Centre number if the server can't be reached.

cases.what: Emergency data to the emergency IP and PVT data to the state backend at the same time
SMS fallback when the emergency server is unreachable, in the Table 4C ii) format
Clear emergency from the emergency server or the Control Centre number, command 020
Emergency control SMS centre number, command 021

steps.do: Disconnect the vehicle's main power from the device.
With the device asleep or idle, switch the ignition on.
Switch the ignition off and on five times within a minute, ending on.
Press SOS again to end the emergency (or clear it from the server).
Press SOS once more — Runway holds back its acknowledgement; do nothing else.
With the device asleep, press SOS.
With the device asleep, disconnect then reconnect main power.
With the device asleep, open the cover.
Take a sharp turn left, then right.
Drive normally for ten minutes — no harsh alert may come.
Take the device out of coverage (or remove the antenna) for five minutes, then back.
Keep it offline for half an hour, then let it reconnect.
